title: 第009章 答应我翻脸了第010章 杀红眼的李玄
slug: 我能给箭术加点从猎户到斩仙
content_zh:
与昨日不同的是，两人脸上都带着一种刻意矜持却又掩不住得意的笑容。
王媒婆正口若悬河，对着围观的村民吹嘘：
“瞧瞧！
这就是诚意！
徐家姑娘亲自来了！
李三郎昨日那番话，那是情真意切！
一百两、金玉、苏缎，这才是配得上我们玉莲姑娘的排场！
李家虽然眼下艰难，但这份心，金子不换！”
见李玄兄弟回来，人群自动分开一条道。
所有目光，好奇的、嘲弄的、同情的、幸灾乐祸的，都聚焦过来。
王媒婆眼睛一亮，快步迎上，脸上的笑容如同菊花般绽放：
“哎哟！
三郎回来了！
快，快！
徐家婶子和玉莲姑娘可等你半天了！
昨日你说的那些，我们可都记在心里了！
这不大清早就来了，这诚意，这脸面，啧啧！”
李忠和王氏已经面无血色地站在屋门口。
李山被李秀儿搀着，胸口剧烈起伏，死死盯着小儿子。
生怕他下一刻就说出什么无法挽回的话。

围观的村民也屏住呼吸。
就在这时，李玄忽然抬手拍了拍自己脑门。
脸上堆起一种混杂着懊恼和“豁然开朗”
的粗粝笑容，声音洪亮得所有人都能听见：
“哎呀！
看我这记性！
王婶你这么一说，我可算想起来了！
对对对！
昨日我是说了！
一百两！
金镯子！
玉簪子！
上好的苏缎！”
他这话一出，李忠腿一软，王氏捂住嘴，李山眼前一黑。
围观众人哗然！
这李老三，真认了？！
王媒婆和徐家母女则是眼睛骤亮，喜色几乎要溢出来！
王媒婆拍手笑道：“这就对了！
三郎果然是明白人！
重情重义！”

徐玉莲也抬起头，眼中的羞怯被一丝得逞的亮光取代，声音娇柔：
“李三哥……你、你真这么想？”
content_en:
Different from yesterday, both of them had a deliberately reserved but unable to hide a proud smile on their faces.
Matchmaker Wang was eloquent and boasted to the onlookers:
"Look!
This is sincerity!
The girl from the Xu family is here in person!
What Li Sanlang said yesterday was truly sincere!
One hundred taels, gold, jade, and satin, this is the pomp and circumstance worthy of our girl Yulian!
Although the Li family is in a difficult situation right now, their heart cannot be exchanged for gold! "
Seeing brother Li Xuan return, the crowd automatically separated into a lane.
All eyes, curious, mocking, sympathetic, and gloating, were focused on him.
Matchmaker Wang's eyes lit up and she hurried forward to meet her. The smile on her face bloomed like a chrysanthemum:
"Ouch!
Saburo is back!
Quick, quick!
Aunt Xu and Miss Yulian have been waiting for you for a long time!
We all remember what you said yesterday!
This came so early in the morning, this sincerity, this face, tsk tsk! "
Li Zhong and Wang were already standing at the door of the house with pale faces.
Li Shan was being supported by Li Xiu'er, his chest was rising and falling violently, and he was staring at his youngest son.
I was afraid that he would say something irreparable the next moment.
The surrounding villagers also held their breath.
At this moment, Li Xuan suddenly raised his hand and patted his forehead.
There was a mixture of annoyance and "sudden enlightenment" on his face.
With a rough smile, his voice was loud enough for everyone to hear:
"Ouch!
Look at my memory!
Aunt Wang, when you said that, I finally remembered it!
Yes, yes!
I said it yesterday!
One hundred taels!
Gold bracelet!
Hosta!
Excellent sudsin! "
As soon as he said these words, Li Zhong's legs went weak, Wang covered his mouth, and Li Shan's eyesight went dark.
The onlookers were in an uproar!
Li Laosan, do you really admit it? !
Matchmaker Wang and the Xu family's mother and daughter's eyes suddenly brightened, and their joy almost overflowed!
Matchmaker Wang clapped her hands and smiled: "That's right!
Saburo is indeed a sensible person!
Love and justice! "
Xu Yulian also raised her head, the shyness in her eyes was replaced by a glimmer of success, and her voice was soft:
"Brother Li San...you, you really think so?"
